craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 22. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 10. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: The rest is clearly therefore not told here in detail again; having made the maṇḍala, having worshipped the god there with kuśa grass — and.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭamato neha kathitaṃ vistarātpunaḥ kṛtvā maṇḍalamabhyarcya tatra devaṃ kuśairatha
